description: This file defines the Drupal core render element class for tables, including properties, processing, validation, and pre-rendering methods for rendering tables in Drupal forms.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A render element class for rendering tables in Drupal forms, supporting features like headers, rows, responsiveness, sticky headers, and table drag support.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns default properties and settings for the table render element.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Processes the value of the table element, especially for tables with selectable rows.

methods.name: processTable
methods.description: Adds tableselect support, attaches libraries, and prepares table rows and headers for rendering.

methods.name: validateTable
methods.description: Validates that at least one row is selected if the table is configured for selection.

methods.name: preRenderTable
methods.description: Transforms children elements into a renderable table structure, adding attributes, classes, and behaviors.
